title: ModuloGUI
description: An all-in-one client-side utility mod for Minecraft 1.21
body:
**ModuloGUI** is an all-in-one client-side utility mod for Minecraft 1.21 (Fabric) featuring a polished in-game GUI for toggling and customizing a wide set of quality-of-life features.

**Features**

**HUD Elements**
Armor display, item count, held item durability, coordinates, direction compass, day/time clock, FPS, ping, speed, potion effects, horse stats, and minimap — all individually positioned and styled with per-element background, outline, text color, and opacity controls

Keystrokes overlay with live CPS counter

Block info HUD showing the block currently under your crosshair

**Inventory**
Container preview: hover over any chest, shulker box, or bundle to see its contents as a tooltip — supports scrolling for large containers

Mouse Tweaks: hold shift and drag across slots to batch-transfer matching items in one motion

Menu Opacity: independently control the background darkening behind inventory screens and the opacity of the inventory panel texture itself

Menu Colors: apply one of 20 curated presets (Midnight, Carbon, Nord, Catppuccin, Gruvbox, and more) or set fully custom colors for the ModuloGUI interface and inventory panel tint

Scrollable tooltips

**Gameplay**
Toggle Sprint and Toggle Sneak

Zoom with smooth, configurable zoom factor and sensitivity

FOV Effects control: independently suppress FOV changes from sprinting, speed potions, elytra, bows, and spyglass; suppress nausea/portal distortion overlay

No fire overlay: hides the fire screen effect without disabling damage

Custom crosshair editor with up to 32×32 pixel grid

AppleSkin integration: food saturation and hunger preview overlays

**World Overlays**
Light level overlay: colored X markers on surfaces (red = unsafe, yellow = marginal) with configurable radius and colors

Hitbox renderer with configurable color and in-range highlighting

Block outline customizer

Chunk border renderer with configurable colors and thickness for outer and inner grids

Waypoints with automatic death point tracking

**Interface**
Scoreboard tweaks: hide entirely or show text only without the background panel

Particle effects manager: per-particle visibility, color, and size overrides

Fullbright with configurable gamma value

Performance mode and crystal optimizer

Chat toggle

All features are toggled and configured from an in-game hub (default key: O) with no need to edit config files. Supports multiple profiles.
